title: List a sortie's model rounds with role, model and duration
goal: The sortie read returns each consultant and Misato round in order with its model and duration
acceptance: A test: a sortie with a consult, three steps and a reply returns four or five rounds in event order with role, model (when recorded) and durationMs
misato.step and misato.reply events record the model that answered, when they do not yet
Event schema and payload caps unchanged or versioned as src/events.ts requires
privacy: Neutral invented sorties and model names only.
escalation: An event schema version change goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one ledger query over existing events, the model on step events and tests. Not a measurement.
